fullDescription: A frameless dark-mode SaaS pricing page with a 3-tier card grid, monthly-annual toggle and a glowing electric-mint highlighted plan, built for developer and design tools.

structured.summary: A frameless, full-width dark SaaS pricing page for a developer/design tool, built around a 3-tier card grid (Starter / Pro / Team) with a centered monthly-annual billing toggle, a mint-green electric accent, and a quiet mono/grotesk type system. The whole page reads as 'expensive minimal dev-tool': near-black canvas, hairline borders, subtle radial glow behind the headline, one glowing highlighted middle tier, and a feature checklist per card.

style.description: Electric-on-black dark mode. The canvas is near-black ink (#08090c) with a faint top-center radial glow in the mint accent. Surfaces are layered by lightness: panel (#0d0f14) and card (#101319) on the ink base, separated by 1px hairline borders (#1b1f29) rather than shadows. The single accent is an electric mint-green (#7df9c0, dimmer hover #39e89a) used sparingly for the logo chip, the highlighted tier ring/CTA, the toggle knob, badges and check icons. Text runs three weights of grey: muted (#7c8398) for body/labels, soft (#aab1c4) for secondary, pure white for headings/prices. Prices use a white-to-grey vertical gradient clipped to text (#ffffff -> #c9cedd). Type: Inter for body/UI, Space Grotesk for display headings + tier names + prices (tight tracking), JetBrains Mono available for mono accents. Generous rounding (rounded-2xl cards, rounded-xl buttons, full-round pills). No drop shadows except a soft mint glow ring on the featured card.
style.prompt: Design in dark mode on a near-black canvas (#08090c) with a faint top-center radial glow in mint (rgba(125,249,192,0.10) fading to transparent). Layer surfaces by lightness: cards #101319, panels #0d0f14, all separated by crisp 1px hairline borders #1b1f29, never drop shadows. Use ONE accent only: electric mint-green #7df9c0 (hover #39e89a) for the logo chip, the highlighted plan's border/ring/CTA, the toggle knob, small pills and check icons; everything else stays monochrome. Text in a grey ramp: #7c8398 muted body, #aab1c4 soft secondary, #ffffff headings and prices. Render big prices in a white-to-grey vertical gradient clipped to the glyphs (#ffffff top -> #c9cedd bottom). Typography: Inter for UI/body, Space Grotesk for display headlines, tier names and prices with tight negative tracking, JetBrains Mono for any mono detail. Rounding is generous: rounded-2xl cards, rounded-xl buttons, fully-rounded pills. Add a single soft mint glow ring (box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(125,249,192,0.55), 0 24px 60px -24px rgba(125,249,192,0.35)) only on the featured tier.

layout_and_structure.description: Frameless, responsive full-width web page (no surrounding device/browser frame), centered to a max-w-6xl column with px-6 gutters. Vertical flow: sticky translucent nav -> centered hero with eyebrow pill, two-line headline, subhead and billing toggle -> the 3-column pricing grid (the page's centerpiece) -> a reassurance trust row -> a two-column FAQ -> a logo-cloud + copyright footer. The pricing grid reflows 3 -> 2 -> 1 column (lg / md / base); the middle Pro card is visually lifted and ringed to draw the eye.

prompts.prompt: Sticky top nav (h-16), translucent ink background (bg-ink/80) with backdrop-blur-xl and a bottom hairline border. Left: a small mint rounded square logo chip with a sparkle icon next to a Space Grotesk wordmark in white, followed by horizontal text links (Library, Templates, Docs, Pricing) in muted grey that go white on hover, with the current page link already white; links hide below md. Right: a quiet 'Sign in' text link plus a solid white pill 'Start free' CTA with dark ink text.

Centered hero inside the max-w-6xl column, generous top padding (pt-28). Top: a small pill badge with border + card fill, a tiny mint status dot, and a metric line like '12,000+ production-ready design prompts'. Then a large two-line Space Grotesk headline in white (up to ~64px, leading ~1.06, tight tracking) such as 'Pricing that scales / with your craft.'. Below it a single muted-grey subhead sentence, max-w-xl, centered.

Centered monthly/annual billing toggle below the subhead. A row of: 'Monthly' label (white when active), a pill switch (h-8 w-[60px], card fill, hairline border) with a mint round knob that slides ~28px to the right when toggled, then 'Annual' label (muted when inactive) and a small mint-tinted pill reading '2 months free'. Toggling swaps every price to its annual value and updates the '/ month' suffix and the 'Billed monthly/yearly' subline.

Three pricing cards in a responsive grid that reflows 3 cols (lg) -> 2 cols (md) -> 1 col (base), gap-5. Each card: rounded-2xl, card fill, 1px hairline border, p-7, flex column. Card top: a small phosphor icon + tier name in Space Grotesk white, a one-line muted description. Then the price block: a huge gradient-clipped price ($0 / $20 / $60) with a small grey unit beside it ('forever', '/ month'), and a tiny grey subline ('No card required', 'Billed monthly', 'Per editor, billed monthly'). Then a full-width CTA button (h-11, rounded-xl). Then a hairline divider, then a feature checklist with mint or soft check icons and a leading 'Everything in <lower tier>, plus' item. Tiers: Starter $0 (rocket icon, outline ghost button 'Get started'), Pro $20 (the highlighted tier), Team $60 (users icon, outline ghost button 'Start team trial').

The middle Pro card is the hero of the grid: lifted up (lg:-mt-4) above its neighbors, mint-tinted border (border-acc/40), a subtle vertical gradient fill (from card to panel), and a soft mint glow ring (the ring-acc box-shadow). It carries a centered 'MOST POPULAR' pill (solid mint, dark uppercase text) pinned to its top edge, a lightning icon, a small mint 'Save 17%' badge in the header row, white feature text on the first item, mint check icons, and a SOLID mint CTA 'Upgrade to Pro' with dark ink text (hover -> dimmer mint).

Below the grid, a centered single row of three small trust items in muted grey, each a mint phosphor icon + short label: '14-day money-back guarantee', 'Cancel anytime', 'SOC 2 Type II'. Wraps gracefully on narrow widths.

FAQ section on a faintly lighter panel band (bg-panel/40) with a top hairline border, narrowed to max-w-3xl. Centered Space Grotesk heading 'Frequently asked', then a vertical list of rows divided by hairlines. Each row is a two-column grid on sm+ (a ~200px white question label on the left, a muted-grey answer paragraph on the right), stacking to one column on mobile. 3-4 concise Q/A pairs.

Footer on the ink base with a top hairline border. First a centered small uppercase wide-tracked label ('Trusted by teams shipping faster'), then a dimmed (opacity ~55%) logo cloud of 5 monochrome brand wordmarks each with a small phosphor glyph, wrapping centered. Then a hairline divider and a bottom row (stacks on mobile, space-between on sm+): the mint logo chip + small wordmark on the left, a muted copyright line on the right.

special_ui_components.description: The center pricing card is elevated and ringed to steer choice: lifted vertically above siblings, mint border, card->panel gradient fill, a soft mint glow shadow ring, a pinned solid-mint 'MOST POPULAR' uppercase pill, a solid-mint primary CTA, and mint check icons. The two flanking tiers stay flat with hairline borders and outline ghost buttons.
special_ui_components.prompt: Make the middle plan card the focal point: raise it ~16px above the side cards, give it a mint-tinted border and a card-to-panel vertical gradient fill, and wrap it in a soft mint glow ring (1px mint inner ring + a large blurred mint drop-glow). Pin a centered solid-mint pill with dark uppercase 'MOST POPULAR' text to its top edge. Its primary CTA is solid mint with ink text; the other two cards use transparent/panel outline buttons with white text. Use mint check icons inside the featured card, soft-grey checks in the others.

special_ui_components.description: A pill switch with a sliding mint knob and a '2 months free' incentive pill that recomputes every price and billing subline live when flipped.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build a pill toggle (rounded-full, hairline border, dark card fill) with a mint round knob that animates a ~28px horizontal slide via a cubic-bezier transition. Flank it with 'Monthly' and 'Annual' labels whose color flips between white (active) and muted grey, plus a small mint-tinted '2 months free' pill. On toggle, swap each card's price text to its annual figure, switch '/ month' suffixes, and update the 'Billed monthly' -> 'Billed yearly' sublines (including the 'Per editor' variant).

special_ui_components.description: Oversized prices rendered with a white-to-grey vertical gradient clipped to the glyphs, paired with a tiny grey unit label.
special_ui_components.prompt: Render each tier price as an oversized Space Grotesk number (text-5xl, font-700, tight leading) filled with a top-to-bottom gradient (#ffffff -> #c9cedd) clipped to the text, sitting on a transparent fill. Align a small muted-grey unit word beside it on the baseline ('forever' or '/ month') and a tiny grey qualifying subline beneath.

special_ui_components.description: Per-card feature checklists separated from the CTA by a faded edge-to-edge hairline, with check-icon rows.
special_ui_components.prompt: Separate the CTA from the feature list with a 1px horizontal hairline that fades at both ends (transparent -> faint white 6% -> transparent). Below it list features as rows: a small check icon (mint on the featured card, soft grey elsewhere) aligned to the top of wrapping text, ~14px spacing, the first row reading 'Everything in <previous tier>, plus' with brighter text.

structured.special_notes: This is a FRAMELESS, responsive full-bleed web page, not a screenshot inside a device/browser chrome: render edge-to-edge with a sticky translucent nav that blurs content behind it. The page is single-column-of-sections, each section centered to a max-w-6xl (FAQ to max-w-3xl) container with px-6 gutters. The pricing grid is the only multi-column block and must reflow 3 -> 2 -> 1 columns at lg/md/base breakpoints; the featured card un-lifts (mt resets) when it stacks. Keep the palette strictly monochrome + the single mint accent; rely on hairline borders and one glow ring instead of heavy shadows. Icons are Phosphor (iconify ph:*). The billing toggle is interactive and must rewrite prices/sublines on flip.
